description: This file contains Python code for parsing and managing process and UID information on Android devices, including classes for Process, Uid, and ProcessSet, as well as functions for parsing process and UID data.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Represents an Android process with attributes uid, pid, ppid, and name.

classes.name: Uid
classes.description: Represents a UID with attributes uid and name.

classes.name: ProcessSet
classes.description: Manages a collection of processes and UIDs, with methods to update and find processes and UIDs.

methods.name: DisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of a process, prioritizing process name, then UID name, then PID.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of Process or Uid objects.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the process and UID lists.

methods.name: UpdateProcesses
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of processes from adb.

methods.name: UpdateUids
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of UIDs from adb.

methods.name: FindPid
methods.description: Finds a Process object by pid, updating if necessary, or creates a synthetic process if not found.

methods.name: FindUid
methods.description: Finds a Uid object by uid, updating if necessary, or creates a new Uid if not found.

methods.name: UpdateCount
methods.description: Returns the counts of process and UID updates.
